/method/: How a claim is graded (doc, inf, lore, open) and the rules for reading a register. Nothing else states them.
/sources/: The register of sources, with how each was read and how well each claim resting on it is known. Now also carries the Deep dives section (the DNA, Disputed) and an Atlas note.
/searched/: Every query this archive ran, in sets, with its question, answer, note and verdict. The Atlas has the source and volume marks only. Now carries an Atlas note.
/open-questions/: The open questions, each with the record set that would answer it.
/errands/: The places where someone standing at a counter could settle a question, with addresses.
/worklist/: The work list: every task by number, owner and date. The only place the reason for a decision is kept.
/corrections/: Every claim published and taken back, with the cause named.
/documents/: The transcribed documents, read from the images.
/gallery/: Every document image on the site with its caption and a link to where it is read.
/whats-new/: What was read, found and corrected lately, newest first.
/dna/: Two descendants' DNA tests and what they say about the Cape. A deep dive, now under Sources & method.
/disputed/: The MyHeritage tree's contradictions, set side by side. A deep dive, now under Sources & method.
